project.name: Glide-Path LEAPS Rebalancing Strategy
project.description: Adds a glide-path overlay to the existing DRIFT rebalancing strategy. Target weights become a time-varying function of the NAV multiple m(t) = NAV / Rf-compounded-contributed-capital. DRIFT rebalancing is unchanged and two-sided; de-levering is achieved by updating targets monthly, not by directional rules.
project.overview: The glide path is a DRIFT refinement, not a new RebalanceRule. Presence of glide_path_config on PortfolioConfig activates two behaviors: (1) monthly atomic update of hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights on PortfolioState; (2) DRIFT reads from state.dynamic_target_weights instead of ctx.w. Two pure functions drive the schedule: glide_path_leaps_weight(m, w0, floor, half_life_multiple) for the LEAPS weight and compute_glide_target_weights(m, config, glidepath_config) for the full normalized weight vector. VTI enters target_weights with initial weight 0.0 and is rebalanced symmetrically as any other base asset. GTT re-entry seeds LEAPS and base assets at compute_glide_target_weights(m_current) * total.

data_schemas.name: GlidepathConfig
data_schemas.description: Frozen configuration for the glide-path overlay. Stored on PortfolioConfig.glide_path_config. Activates when non-None on a RebalanceRule.DRIFT portfolio. drift_band is not a field here — it is DRIFT_BAND_RELATIVE from consts.py, shared by all DRIFT rebalancing. Independent of LeapsConfig (pricing) and GttConfig (market-timing).

fields.name: half_life_multiple
fields.description: NAV multiple (of hurdle-adjusted contributed capital) at which the active LEAPS weight above the floor halves. Default 2.0.

fields.name: floor
fields.description: Minimum LEAPS target weight at any wealth level. Default 0.05. Must be < leaps_fraction (w0).

fields.name: vti_alpha
fields.description: Fraction of freed LEAPS weight routed to VTI as m grows; remainder (1 - vti_alpha) expands diversified base assets proportionally to their original weights. Default 0.65. Must be in [0.0, 1.0]. Constant — all m-adaptive behavior is in w(m).

data_schemas.name: PortfolioConfig (glide_path_config extension)
data_schemas.description: PortfolioConfig gains one optional field. None preserves existing QUARTERLY/DRIFT behavior exactly. When set, __post_init__ validates: rebalance_rule == DRIFT, floor < leaps_fraction, half_life_multiple > 0, 0.0 <= vti_alpha <= 1.0, and 'VTI' is present in target_weights with value 0.0.

fields.name: glide_path_config
fields.description: None = glide-path disabled. When set, rebalance_rule must be DRIFT and target_weights must include 'VTI': 0.0.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioState (hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights extensions)
data_schemas.description: PortfolioState gains two new fields carrying glide-path state forward via dataclasses.replace. Both are always present on PortfolioState regardless of rebalance_rule; only written and read when glide_path_config is active.

fields.name: hurdle_contributed
fields.description: Running Rf-compounded contribution denominator for m(t). Initialized to config.initial_nav. Updated monthly: new = old * (1+rfr)^(1/12) + monthly_contribution. When glide_path_config is None, initialized to initial_nav and never modified.

fields.name: dynamic_target_weights
fields.description: Current glide-path target weight vector, indexed by asset ticker. None when glide_path_config is None. When active, initialized to config.target_weights (with VTI=0.0) at m=1.0; updated monthly to compute_glide_target_weights(m). Replaces ctx.w in _should_rebalance and redistribution when not None.

data_schemas.name: BacktestContext (rfr_series unconditional population)
data_schemas.description: No new fields on BacktestContext. The only change: rfr_series is populated whenever config.glide_path_config is not None, regardless of use_leaps. The existing forward-fill and NaN-validation logic apply in this new path.

fields.name: rfr_series
fields.description: Already exists. Now also populated when glide_path_config is present and use_leaps is False. Source: return_data.risk_free_rate (^IRX daily annualized). No new field — existing field populated unconditionally under glide path.

api_contracts.name: glide_path_leaps_weight
api_contracts.description: Pure. Compute the LEAPS target weight at NAV multiple m: w(m) = floor + (w0 - floor) * exp(-lambda * max(m - 1.0, 0.0)), where lambda = ln(2) / half_life_multiple. Returns w0 for m <= 1.0; approaches floor as m -> inf. Placed alongside other pure helpers in _backtest_steps.py.

inputs.name: m
inputs.description: NAV multiple: total_nav / hurdle_contributed. May be < 1.0 (underwater).

inputs.name: w0
inputs.description: Initial LEAPS fraction (ctx.leaps_fraction). Full weight maintained at or below break-even.

inputs.name: floor
inputs.description: Minimum LEAPS target weight. Must be < w0.

inputs.name: half_life_multiple
inputs.description: NAV multiple at which active weight (w0 - floor) halves. Must be > 0.

api_contracts.name: compute_glide_target_weights
api_contracts.description: Pure. Compute the full normalized target weight vector at NAV multiple m. Allocates freed LEAPS weight (w_freed = w0 - w_leaps) as: vti_alpha * w_freed to VTI; (1 - vti_alpha) * w_freed distributed proportionally among non-VTI base assets by their original weights. Sum invariant: result.sum() == 1.0. At m == 1.0, result equals config.target_weights (with VTI=0.0). VTI weight and all base weights are monotone non-decreasing in m.

inputs.name: m
inputs.description: NAV multiple. m <= 1.0 returns original target_weights (no de-levering).

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Source of original target_weights (including 'VTI': 0.0) and leaps_fraction.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Target weight Series indexed by ticker. sum() == 1.0 within 1e-12 for all m >= 0.

raises: ValueError: if base_sum == 0 (no non-LEAPS, non-VTI assets)

api_contracts.name: _apply_contribution (hurdle and dynamic targets atomic update)
api_contracts.description: Existing _apply_contribution fires on is_month_end. When glide_path_config is present: (1) compute new_hurdle = state.hurdle_contributed * (1+rfr)^(1/12) + config.monthly_contribution; (2) compute m = nav_before / new_hurdle; (3) compute new_targets = compute_glide_target_weights(m, config, glidepath_config); (4) return state updated with both fields in a single dataclasses.replace call. Must complete before _apply_rebalance reads either field. Non-glide-path paths unchanged.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Current frozen state with hurdle_contributed from prior month-end and dynamic_target_weights from prior update.

inputs.name: ctx
inputs.description: Provides config (monthly_contribution, glide_path_config, target_weights) and rebalance_rule.

inputs.name: nav_before
inputs.description: Pre-contribution NAV; used as total_nav for computing m.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights both updated atomically on is_month_end when glide_path_config present. Unchanged on non-month-end days or when glide_path_config is None.

api_contracts.name: _apply_rebalance (dynamic target_w source)
api_contracts.description: Existing _apply_rebalance DRIFT path unchanged except for the source of target weights: target_w = state.dynamic_target_weights if state.dynamic_target_weights is not None else ctx.w. Both _should_rebalance and the redistribution step read from target_w. All other DRIFT logic (leaps_scale, partial-close, two-sided rebalancing) is reused without modification. LEAPS may be topped up or trimmed by standard DRIFT. De-levering effect comes entirely from the monthly target update.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Post-contribution state; dynamic_target_weights already updated for this month-end.

inputs.name: ctx
inputs.description: Provides ctx.w (fallback when dynamic_target_weights is None), leaps_fraction, base_target_w.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Provides date, spot, rfr for LEAPS pricing and rebalance execution.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with holdings, leaps_scale, and leaps_value updated by DRIFT against dynamic_target_weights. Unchanged if drift band not breached.

api_contracts.name: _apply_gtt_reentry (glide-path-adjusted seed and allocation)
api_contracts.description: When glide_path_config is present and a Defensive->Long GTT transition fires: (1) compute m_current = total / state.hurdle_contributed; (2) call compute_glide_target_weights(m_current, config, glide_path_config) to get current dynamic targets; (3) seed LEAPS with dynamic_targets[leaps_key] * total; (4) allocate each base asset (including VTI) at dynamic_targets[a] * total. VTI receives its current dynamic target allocation from full NAV — treated identically to any other base asset. This is a full rebalance to current dynamic targets, consistent with non-glide-path re-entry behavior. Non-GTT and non-glide-path paths unchanged.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Frozen state at the Defensive->Long transition date, with valid hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights.

inputs.name: ctx
inputs.description: Provides rebalance_rule, glide_path_config, leaps_fraction, base_target_w, underlying_prices, rfr_series.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Provides date, spot, rfr, raw_vix_value for LEAPS contract creation.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with LEAPS seeded at dynamic_targets[leaps_key] * total and all base assets (including VTI) allocated at their current dynamic targets.

api_contracts.name: _build_context (rfr_series and VTI validation for glide path)
api_contracts.description: When config.glide_path_config is not None: (1) populate rfr_series from return_data.risk_free_rate with forward-fill, regardless of use_leaps; (2) assert 'VTI' present in return_data.returns.columns; (3) assert rfr_series has no leading NaNs before the backtest start date. All existing _build_context logic is unchanged; this is an additional validation and population block gated on glide_path_config presence.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Portfolio config; glide_path_config field triggers the new population/validation path.

inputs.name: return_data
inputs.description: Must contain risk_free_rate (^IRX) and returns DataFrame with 'VTI' column when glide_path_config is set.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Fully validated context with rfr_series populated when glide_path_config present, regardless of use_leaps.

raises: ValueError: if glide_path_config is not None and 'VTI' absent from return_data.returns.columns
ValueError: if glide_path_config is not None and rfr_series has leading NaNs before the backtest start date

features.name: glide_path_leaps_weight() pure function
features.description: Add pure function glide_path_leaps_weight(m, w0, floor, half_life_multiple) to _backtest_steps.py alongside existing pure helpers. Implements: lam = ln(2) / half_life_multiple; active = (w0 - floor) * exp(-lam * max(m-1.0, 0.0)); return floor + active. Key invariants: w(m<=1.0)==w0; w(m)->floor as m->inf; monotone non-increasing for m>=1.

invariants.accounting_oracle: w(1.0) == w0 exactly (exp(0)=1); w(inf) -> floor (exp->0); result in [floor, w0] for all m >= 0.

features.name: compute_glide_target_weights() pure function
features.description: Add pure function compute_glide_target_weights(m, config, glidepath_config) -> pd.Series to _backtest_steps.py. Computes w_leaps = glide_path_leaps_weight(m, w0, floor, half_life_multiple); w_freed = w0 - w_leaps; distributes w_freed as: vti_alpha * w_freed to 'VTI', (1-vti_alpha) * w_freed proportionally among non-LEAPS non-VTI base assets by their original weights. When glide_path_config is None, _should_rebalance uses ctx.w — no regression to existing behavior.
NAV is conserved across any DRIFT rebalance: sum(holdings_new)+leaps_new == sum(holdings_old)+leaps_old within 1e-6.
LEAPS is topped up (not just trimmed) when its weight is below dynamic target by more than drift band — two-sided behavior confirmed.

tests/test_glide_path_rebalance_integration.py: 25-year synthetic DRIFT+glide_path backtest; assert LEAPS weight tracks dynamic target within drift band over time; assert LEAPS is both topped up and trimmed at different m values.

VTI weight in dynamic_target_weights grows from 0 to positive: DRIFT routes capital to VTI when base assets become overweight.
m falls below 1.0 after drawdown: dynamic_target_weights returns to original weights (VTI target back to 0.0, LEAPS target back to w0); DRIFT tops up LEAPS toward w0.

features.name: _apply_gtt_reentry glide-path-adjusted allocation
features.description: Modify _apply_gtt_reentry to use compute_glide_target_weights when glide_path_config is present. At a Defensive->Long GTT transition: (1) compute m_current = total / state.hurdle_contributed; (2) dynamic_targets = compute_glide_target_weights(m_current, config, glide_path_config); (3) seed LEAPS with dynamic_targets[leaps_key] * total; (4) allocate each base asset (including VTI) at dynamic_targets[a] * total. VTI receives its current dynamic target allocation from total NAV — treated identically to any other base asset. Non-glide-path and non-GTT paths unchanged.

invariants.temporal_bounds: m_current = total / state.hurdle_contributed at the re-entry date — no forward values.
invariants.accounting_oracle: sum(dynamic_targets.values()) == 1.0 within 1e-12. sum(new_holdings.values()) + new_leaps_value == total within 1e-6 post-reentry.
invariants.plausibility_range: LEAPS seed weight in [floor, w0]; VTI allocation in [0, w0 * vti_alpha * total]; total NAV conserved within 1e-6.
invariants.realism_requirements: Integration test must exercise at least one Defensive->Long transition after m > 1.5 to verify m-adjusted seed and VTI allocation.

risks.description: Step ordering hazard: if _apply_rebalance reads dynamic_target_weights before _apply_contribution has updated them for the current month-end, DRIFT fires against stale targets.
risks.mitigation: Enforce in the backtest loop that _apply_contribution (which atomically updates hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights) always completes before _apply_rebalance on is_month_end days. Add an explicit ordering comment in the dispatch. Verified by the integration test in F-GP-06/F-GP-07.

risks.description: rfr_series None-dereference for non-LEAPS glide-path backtests: if _build_context is not modified, rfr_series remains None when use_leaps=False, causing AttributeError in _apply_contribution when reading inputs.rfr for the hurdle update.
risks.mitigation: F-GP-05 populates rfr_series whenever glide_path_config is present regardless of use_leaps. Unit test in F-GP-05 exercises this path directly.

risks.description: Regression to existing DRIFT/QUARTERLY behavior: conditional mis-scoping in the modified _apply_contribution or _apply_rebalance could silently alter non-glide-path DRIFT behavior.
risks.mitigation: All glide-path branches are guarded by explicit glide_path_config is not None checks. Existing DRIFT and QUARTERLY test suite must pass without modification (acceptance criterion in F-GP-07).

risks.description: PortfolioState schema extension breaks existing construction sites: adding hurdle_contributed (required float) and dynamic_target_weights (required Series | None) causes all existing PortfolioState call sites not providing these fields to raise TypeError.
risks.mitigation: Audit all PortfolioState construction sites in _backtest_steps.py and tests/ before adding fields. Use defaults or update all call sites in the same commit. Tests in F-GP-04 verify construction and immutability.

risks.description: Spurious VTI rebalance at m=1.0: if dynamic_target_weights['VTI'] is not exactly 0.0 at m=1.0 due to floating-point accumulation, DRIFT may fire a small VTI buy on the first month-end.
risks.mitigation: compute_glide_target_weights invariant test (F-GP-03) asserts VTI==0.0 at m==1.0 within 1e-12. At m==1.0 w_freed==0.0 exactly (w_leaps==w0), so the multiplication result is 0.0 in float64 — not an accumulation path.

risks.description: GTT re-entry VTI allocation inconsistency: if _apply_gtt_reentry uses ctx.leaps_fraction (pre-glide-path fixed weight) rather than compute_glide_target_weights, LEAPS is over-seeded and VTI receives zero allocation.
risks.mitigation: F-GP-08 specifies that _apply_gtt_reentry calls compute_glide_target_weights(m_current) explicitly when glide_path_config is present. Acceptance criterion verifies LEAPS seed and VTI allocation match dynamic_targets * total within 1e-6.

risks.description: Atomic update violation: if hurdle_contributed and dynamic_target_weights are updated in separate dataclasses.replace calls, an intermediate PortfolioState exists with inconsistent hurdle/targets.
risks.mitigation: F-GP-06 explicitly requires both fields updated in a single dataclasses.replace call. Code review must confirm there is no intermediate replace between the two updates.
